scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @aura/server & npm run dev -w @aura/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aura/shared && npm run build -w @aura/server && npm run build -w @aura/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @aura/shared && npm run typecheck -w @aura/server && npm run typecheck -w @aura/web
scripts.postinstall: cd src/server && npx --no-install prisma generate && cd ../.. && npm run build -w @aura/shared
